page_title: RSO 2-1 BAR | Real Sociedad v Barcelona 18/01/2026, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+9' Jesus Manzano shows a yellow card to Frenkie de Jong (Barcelona) for his unsportsmanlike behavior after the match has ended.
90+9' That's the end of the match.
90+9' Fermín (Barcelona) fails to send a pass into the box as his effort is cut out.

90+8' Roony Bardghji (Barcelona) latches on to a precise defence-splitting pass and drills a nice strike from a promising distance towards the middle of the goal. Alex Remiro has a clear sight of it and makes a comfortable save.
90+6' Lamine Yamal (Barcelona) controls a nice low pass and shoots from just outside the box, but it's a poor effort that flies into the stands. Wasted opportunity!
90+4' A dangerous looking corner kick from Lamine Yamal (Barcelona) is cleared to safety by the defence.
90+4' Marcus Rashford (Barcelona) delivers a promising cross into the box, but it's cleared. The ball goes out of play. Barcelona are awarded a corner kick.
90+3' Marcus Rashford (Barcelona) takes the corner but the ball crashes against the post!
90+3' Corner kick. Marcus Rashford (Barcelona) is ready to send the ball into the box.
90+2' Fermín (Barcelona) receives a neat pass inside the box and instantly thumps the ball goalward, but a defender makes a last ditch block to deny him.
90' The fourth official shows 9 min. of added time.

90' Gerard Martin (Barcelona) carelessly slides into the feet of his opponent and he'll be lucky to avoid punishment. Jesus Manzano blows for the foul but keeps his cards in his pocket on this occasion.
88' The ref makes the signal that the yellow is cancelled but immediately brandishes a straight red to Carlos Soler (Real Sociedad). He’s distraught but has to leave the field of play.

87' It's been a while since that contentious challenge by Carlos Soler (Real Sociedad), but referee Jesus Manzano must have received some information as he makes the VAR signal. He's going to review and it could result in a red card!
86' Carlos Soler (Real Sociedad) makes a really bad tackle on his opponent and is relieved when the referee only shows him a yellow card.
86' Hansi Flick has decided to make a change. Gerard Martin (Barcelona) replaces Pau Cubarsi.
85' A substitution has been made. Jules Kounde goes off and Roony Bardghji (Barcelona) comes on.
85' Fermín (Barcelona) is booked.
85' Jules Kounde (Barcelona) latches on to a superb cross inside the box but only hits the crossbar with a fine header. What a chance!
83' Jesus Manzano shows a yellow card to Robert Lewandowski (Barcelona) for his blatant foul.
82' The referee allows time for a substitution. Jon Aramburu will be replaced by Duje Caleta-Car (Real Sociedad).
80' The resulting corner from Lamine Yamal (Barcelona) only finds one of the defenders, who heads it out of danger.
78' Igor Zubeldia (Real Sociedad) commits a foul and is shown a yellow card without any hesitation from the referee.
76' Eric Garcia (Barcelona) goes into the referee's book. Yellow card.
76' Igor Zubeldia (Real Sociedad) takes the corner but fails to find any of his teammates. The ball is easily cleared out of danger.
75' Real Sociedad work the corner short. The ball is passed to a nearby teammate.
74' Joan Garcia leaps to intercept the corner kick from Goncalo Guedes (Real Sociedad). The ball goes behind for a corner. Real Sociedad will have an opportunity to threaten the opposition's goal.
71' 2 - 1 What a hit! Goncalo Guedes (Real Sociedad) shows good composure inside the box to fire a first-time shot inside the left post. 2:1.
71' Carlos Soler (Real Sociedad) is well placed to meet a cross and sends a difficult header low towards the middle of the goal, but the goalkeeper reacts well to stop the effort.
70' 1 - 1 Goal! Marcus Rashford (Barcelona) ran onto a clever lofted pass from Lamine Yamal and easily beat the keeper with a header into the bottom left corner from close range. 1:1.
69' Pellegrino Matarazzo has decided to substitute Sergio Gomez and he is replaced by Aihen Munoz (Real Sociedad).
69' Takefusa Kubo is being substituted because of an injury. Pellegrino Matarazzo sends Ander Barrenetxea (Real Sociedad) on the pitch.
69' The injury to Takefusa Kubo (Real Sociedad) looks like it might have ended his involvement in this match.
66' Robert Lewandowski (Barcelona) connects with a cross deep inside the box to send a nice header towards the bar. The ball bounces off it, though, and the goalkeeper saves.
64' The attendance for today's match is 36346.
63' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Dani Olmo leaves the pitch and Marcus Rashford (Barcelona) comes on.
62' Hansi Flick prepares a substitution. Alejandro Balde is replaced by Joao Cancelo (Barcelona).
62' That's the end of the game for Ferran Torres, who is replaced by Robert Lewandowski (Barcelona).
60' Dani Olmo (Barcelona) produces a dangerous lofted cross into the box which is intercepted.
58' Here is a change. Brais Mendez is going off and Pellegrino Matarazzo gives the last tactical orders to Alvaro Odriozola (Real Sociedad).
58' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Jon Gorrotxategi (Real Sociedad) comes onto the pitch for Benat Turrientes.
57' Lamine Yamal (Barcelona) decides to have a direct shot at goal from the free kick, but the ball goes high over the top of the crossbar.
57' Jesus Manzano blows his whistle after Takefusa Kubo (Real Sociedad) kicks an opponent's legs instead of the ball. Barcelona earn a free kick which could lead to a goal-scoring opportunity.
55' The resulting corner from Lamine Yamal (Barcelona) is cleared by the opposition's defence.
54' Fermín (Barcelona) attempts to send a low pass into the box from the edge of the penalty area, but the opposition's defence knocks the ball to safety. Now Barcelona have a corner.
51' Jon Aramburu (Real Sociedad) has to be very careful for the rest of the match after receiving a yellow card from the referee for a bad tackle on an opponent.
50' Lamine Yamal (Barcelona) lifts the ball into the box from the corner, but one of the defending players gets there first to head it clear.
49' Alejandro Balde rounds off a good move with a layoff to Dani Olmo (Barcelona) inside the box, he has a clear sight of goal but sends the ball just wide of the left post.

48' OFF THE POST! Dani Olmo (Barcelona) drifts into the box to give his teammate support. He receives a fantastic pass and shoots from close range, but it crashes against the left post. It could have been a brilliant goal, unlucky.
46' The referee blows his whistle to signal the start of the second half.
45+8' Jesus Manzano blows his whistle to signal the end of the first-half action.
45+7' The Barcelona players are stunned as referee Jesus Manzano changes his mind after a VAR review. NO PENALTY! Play to continue.
45+6' Hang on! It might not be a penalty for Barcelona as the ref now wants to review using VAR. This hopefully won't take too long.
45+5' Igor Zubeldia (Real Sociedad) trips an opposition player and Jesus Manzano signals a foul. The referee gives a penalty kick to Barcelona!!

45+4' Fermín (Barcelona) attempts to find his teammate with a pass from outside the box, but the opposition's defence is quick to react and thwarts the attack. The linesman signals a throw-in for Barcelona.

45+3' Lamine Yamal (Barcelona) receives a precise pass and is given time inside the box to send a promising strike towards the left post. Alex Remiro guesses his intentions and denies him with a fine save.
45+3' A good clearance by a defender means the corner comes to nothing for Barcelona.
45' 5 additional min. will be played.
45' A horde of players are waiting inside the penalty area for a cross from the corner, but Lamine Yamal (Barcelona) takes it short.

45' Frenkie de Jong (Barcelona) produces a lovely ball into the penalty area but the defender manages to intercept and comfortably averts the danger. The referee blows his whistle, Barcelona are awarded a corner kick.
43' The corner from Lamine Yamal (Barcelona) is intercepted by Alex Remiro.
42' The defence had a hard time blocking out the strike from Jules Kounde (Barcelona). He didn't hesitate and finished from outside the box right after he had received a pass from his teammate.
41' Nothing comes of the resulting corner from Goncalo Guedes (Real Sociedad). The defence is alert and manages to cut it out.
39' Lamine Yamal (Barcelona) gets on the ball and beats an opponent, but his run is stopped by the referee Jesus Manzano who sees an offensive foul.
38' The resulting corner from Dani Olmo (Barcelona) is cleared by the defence.
37' Dani Olmo (Barcelona) places a shot from the edge of the box towards the left side of the goal, but Alex Remiro makes a terrific save to deny him. Nice play all round!
37' Benat Turrientes (Real Sociedad) takes his opponent down and receives a yellow card from the referee.
36' Benat Turrientes (Real Sociedad) had a good opportunity from long range. His shot was directed under the crossbar, but Joan Garcia was alert and made a comfortable save.
36' Carlos Soler (Real Sociedad) takes the corner kick and sends the ball among a huddle of players inside the penalty area, but one of the defenders clears it to safety.

35' Jon Martin (Real Sociedad) produces a dangerous low pass into the penalty area, but the defence manage to cut it out. The ball is out of play. Real Sociedad will have a chance to score from a corner.

32' 1 - 0 What a goal! Goncalo Guedes plays it to Mikel Oyarzabal (Real Sociedad), who finds himself unmarked inside the box and slots a first-time shot past Joan Garcia into the left side of the goal. 1:0.
29' Here comes the VAR verdict. NO GOAL for Barcelona due to an offside in the build-up play.
28' That looked like an offside in the build-up play and the referee Jesus Manzano is going to take a look using VAR.
27' The assistant referee raises his flag and the referee blows his whistle. Lamine Yamal (Barcelona) puts the ball into the net, but he is flagged for offside.
25' A great solo run by Goncalo Guedes (Real Sociedad) took him deep inside the box, but his weak effort low towards the middle of the goal was easily caught by Joan Garcia.
25' A clever short pass gives Lamine Yamal (Barcelona) a clear goal scoring opportunity, but he fluffs his lines and rifles the ball well wide of the right post.
22' Goncalo Guedes (Real Sociedad) puts a cross into the box from the free kick, but the defender gets there first.
21' Frenkie de Jong (Barcelona) has a goal ruled out for offside!
20' Alejandro Balde (Barcelona) sends a cross into the box, but the opposition's defence clears the ball away to eliminate the danger.
19' Goncalo Guedes (Real Sociedad) crosses the ball into the box, but one of the defending players averts the threat.
17' A pass by Fermín (Barcelona) ends up in no man's land, and the attacking effort comes to an end.
14' Dani Olmo (Barcelona) races through the centre to the edge of the box then lets fly with a rocket of a shot that flies just over the bar.
10' Sergio Gomez (Real Sociedad) jumps into a tackle and Jesus Manzano signals a foul.
9' Here comes the VAR verdict. NO GOAL for Barcelona due to a foul in the build-up play.
8' The Barcelona players halt their celebrations as referee Jesus Manzano makes the VAR signal to review the goal, most likely to ascertain if there was a foul in the build-up play.
7' Fermín (Barcelona) strikes the ball towards goal from the edge of the penalty box and it goes straight inside the left post!
5' Dani Olmo (Barcelona) connected with a pass around the edge of the box, aimed and shot. His attempt went towards the right-hand post, but Alex Remiro was alert and the score remains the same.
4' Fermín (Barcelona) connects with a pass but sees his shot from the edge of the box blocked.
2' A pass into the box finds Pedri (Barcelona) unmarked. He carefully places a shot towards the middle of the goal, but a brilliant last-ditch save by Alex Remiro denies him.
1' A goal, which was scored by Mikel Oyarzabal (Real Sociedad), was disallowed due to offside.
